# Cyntax Innovations

> Uganda-registered technology company in Kampala. We design, build and secure custom software, provide cybersecurity services, implement Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central ERP, and build integrations (URA EFRIS, NSSF, mobile money) and automation for businesses in Uganda and across Africa.

## Company
- [About us](https://cyntaxinnovations.com/about): mission, story, values, industries
- [Our team](https://cyntaxinnovations.com/team): Joseph Mukiibi, Co-Founder & CTO, software developer completing a Master's in Cybersecurity

## Services
- [Web & mobile software](https://cyntaxinnovations.com/services/custom-software)
- [Cybersecurity](https://cyntaxinnovations.com/services/cybersecurity): assessments, secure code review, hardening, awareness training, Data Protection and Privacy Act 2019 readiness
- [ERP & Business Central](https://cyntaxinnovations.com/services/erp)
- [APIs & integrations](https://cyntaxinnovations.com/services/integrations)
- [ICT consulting & strategy](https://cyntaxinnovations.com/services/strategy)
- [Automation & AI](https://cyntaxinnovations.com/services/automation)

## Products
- [ZentroApp](https://cyntaxinnovations.com/products/zentroapp): EFRIS-compliant, offline-first POS and inventory (https://zentroapp.app)
- [Saccolla](https://cyntaxinnovations.com/products/saccolla): SACCO management
- [MediLink](https://cyntaxinnovations.com/products/medilink): healthcare platform
